fairUse.provenance: Noble Knight Games’ direct first-edition listing https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2147486859/Police-Precinct-1st-Edition identifies manufacturer part CMG1003 and the original 2013 English game. The publisher’s official product code list https://commonman.com/policeprecinct/ independently identifies CMG-PP-B-1.0 as its 2013 first edition, and distinguishes the 2014 second edition. Reduced to 360 × 270 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player most recently in contact with law enforcement chooses a character first. Character choice continues clockwise; the last player to choose a character receives the First Player Shield and starts.
clarifications: The law-enforcement criterion chooses the first character picker, not the game’s first turn.
The First Player Shield holder advances the Turn Track at the start of their turns, except on the first turn of the game.
